title: 16-layer tight-tolerance local refinement from iteration_16 best candidate
scientific_hypothesis: Initializing optimization from the iteration_16 second candidate thickness configuration [21.36, 66.22, 44.85, 121.12, 46.71, 23.87, 17.77, 48.79, 27.57, 107.85, 46.87, 27.01, 32.56, 54.29, 77.79, 16.29] nm with tightened ±20% robustness bounds will exploit restored phase-matching conditions and yield higher target scores than the ±25% baseline while maintaining manufacturability.
design_principle: Local gradient-based refinement from a known high-performing configuration with stricter tolerance constraints to identify robustness-performance tradeoff boundary.
proposed_topology: 16-layer alternating sequence: SiO2 | HfO2 | Al2O3 | HfO2 | Al2O3 | SiO2 | HfO2 | Al2O3 | SiO2 | HfO2 | Al2O3 | SiO2 | HfO2 | Al2O3 | SiO2 | HfO2 on fused silica substrate with air incidence
design_variables: Layer thicknesses (16 variables, initialized from iteration_16 candidate_02, bounds 15-200 nm)
manufacturing_considerations: ±20% thickness uniformity tolerance for space qualification
theory_basis: Tolerance-aware design principle from evidence showing theoretical tolerance band incorporation improves fabrication robustness
HfO2 surface unevenness concerns noted in literature require careful thickness control
expected_advantages: Higher robustness score than iteration_16 baseline
Potential target score improvement from 0.5264 toward 0.5453 iteration_05 best
Tighter tolerance may reveal more manufacturable designs
known_risks: Stricter tolerance may reduce achievable target score
Local optimization may converge to same local optimum as iteration_16
HfO2 evaporation inhomogeneity may affect actual performance
execution_request_english: Optimize a 16-layer dielectric stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence from substrate outward: SiO2, HfO2, Al2O3, HfO2, Al2O3, SiO2, HfO2, Al2O3, SiO2, HfO2, Al2O3, SiO2, HfO2, Al2O3, SiO2, HfO2. Initialize thicknesses to [21.36, 66.22, 44.85, 121.12, 46.71, 23.87, 17.77, 48.79, 27.57, 107.85, 46.87, 27.01, 32.56, 54.29, 77.79, 16.29] nm. Optimize all 16 thicknesses with bounds 15-200 nm using gradient-based optimizer. Evaluate transmittance at normal incidence across three bands: 255-280 nm (maximize), 300-700 nm (minimize), 700-1100 nm (minimize). Apply ±20% thickness tolerance for robustness analysis. No metal layers permitted. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 255-280 nm, 300-700 nm, 700-1100 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 255–280 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Transmittance in 300–700 nm; Transmittance in 700–1100 nm. manufacturing constraints: Maximum 30 layers; No metal layers; Only conventional depositable inorganic dielectric materials.
revision_reason: Direct implementation of feedback directive: reinitialize from iteration_16 candidate_02 configuration with tightened ±20% robustness bounds to test whether stricter tolerance constraints yield higher stable peak response.
